Subject: Stream key switchover + registration audit for Sept 15: action items

Hi Elena / Samir —

We’re finalizing the Sept 15 customer webinar and need to lock a few platform items this week so ops can stage the stream:

Key asks (simple checklist):
- ON24 studio access: please share the producer/studio link + staging creds for 0900 PT on Sept 8.
- RTMP fallback: confirm Zoom RTMP endpoint and whether we can pre-stage the fallback so the redirect happens sub-30s. Target bitrate 2.5 Mbps (adaptive).
- Stream keys: vendor (you) will host primary ON24 ingest; Redwood will own the Zoom fallback key. We need the STAGING keys by EOD Sept 3.
- Recording & retention: confirm recording retention duration for post-webinar clip exports (we need 90 days + MP4 export).
- Registration form audit: attached is our current registration_form_v3.xlsx — Marketing (Marissa) requested two extra fields (company size, use case) and separate GDPR consent for EU registrants. Please flag anything that breaks ON24 gating logic.
- Legal / DPA: if you need a signed DPA, send a DocuSign link; Legal wants this done before production keys are shared.

Proposed test window: Sept 8, 13:00–14:00 PT (we can adjust by 30m). Please confirm your availability and who will be producing.

Attachments: registration_form_v3.xlsx, webinar_test_checklist.pdf

Thanks — hoping to close the items quickly so Diego can run a smoke test.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Program Manager, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
m: +1 (415) 555-0192

Thanks Monica — happy to run this. Quick answers inline: 

> ON24 studio access: please share the producer/studio link + staging creds for 0900 PT on Sept 8.
We’ll give producer access. Staging studio URL: https://studio.on24.com/studio/WW-Redwood-staging (temporary creds below). Production creds will be handed over after DPA is signed.
Producer user: webinarworks_producer@webinarworks.co / temp password: Ww!Stage2026 (we’ll rotate after test).

> RTMP fallback: confirm Zoom RTMP endpoint and whether we can pre-stage the fallback so the redirect happens sub-30s.
We support RTMP hot-swap. We’ll pre-configure a fallback route to Zoom; actual switchover relies on Redwood’s edge routing TTL. We can target sub-30s with a warm connection.

> Stream keys: vendor (you) will host primary ON24 ingest; Redwood will own the Zoom fallback key. We need the STAGING keys by EOD Sept 3.
We can provide the ON24 ingest and STAGING stream key today. Please note: primary ON24 key is single-use per session in our pipeline; for staging we’ll give a separate test key.

> Recording & retention: confirm recording retention duration for post-webinar clip exports (we need 90 days + MP4 export).
ON24 retention default is 180 days; MP4 export available. We’ll ensure 90-day retention and give export instructions to your team.

> Registration form audit: attached is our current registration_form_v3.xlsx — Marketing (Marissa) requested two extra fields (company size, use case) and separate GDPR consent for EU registrants. Please flag anything that breaks ON24 gating logic.
I reviewed the sheet — adding those two fields is fine. For EU registrants we recommend the explicit checkbox (not implied consent). We’ll add a consent-locale clause to the gated email.

> Legal / DPA: if you need a signed DPA, send a DocuSign link; Legal wants this done before production keys are shared.
We’ll send a DocuSign powerform for the standard DPA in the next email.

Proposed test window: Sept 8, 13:30–14:30 PT works best for our engineering/producer team. Can you do 13:30 start?

Drive runbook: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB2cRunbook
DocuSign (DPA): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-1234

—Elena

elena@webinarworks.co

- GDPR consent must be explicit for EU registrants. We need the checkbox text exactly: "I consent to Redwood Inference processing my personal data for webinar registration and communications as described in the privacy notice." That checkbox should not be pre-checked.
- Can we also surface an internal hidden field that captures the campaign_id so we can join back to Marketo? (I put an example column in the attached registration_form_marketing_v4.xlsx)
- Regarding recording/export: confirming we can request MP4 clip exports within 7 days of the webinar. Please confirm if there is any added cost for expedited exports.

If DPA is required before keys are handed over, please loop the DocuSign link here when sent.

We prefer the Sept 8 test to start at 13:30 PT to match Elena’s producer availability. Diego — can you confirm staging smoke test time and whether your edge can keep a warm session for quicker switchover?

Thanks —
Marissa
